text:
maria_cs: Quick drop from three onboarding calls today — same asks repeating, pasting raw so we can triage.

maria_cs: TLDR: 1) per-route billing breakdown (Acme, NorthBay) 2) per-route opt-out for continuous batching (low-latency chat) 3) pin embedding model per route for pilots.

zoe_csm: Acme said invoice surprises are a renewal blocker (renewal ~6w). they want an in-console export that maps requests -> invoice lines.

sam_pm: Prioritization? I think batching opt-out is a fast win.

anya_eng: Runtime note: adding a route-level flag to skip batching is small (config check + runtime skip). will need a telemetry dashboard to monitor throughput impact. estimate: 1 sprint + rollout.

devin_sre: For billing visibility, we already emit tokens & request metadata. MVP export/dashboard is analytics work — estimate 1-2 sprints for UI + CSV export.

maria_cs: Also flagged: GreenBridge pilot saw quality regressions after we switched to quantized embeddings. they want a pin to the non-quantized variant per integration.

sam_pm: Embedding-pin sounds medium effort (control-plane + policy). schedule after the fast wins.

triage-bot: @maria_cs created ticket CS-1677: "Per-route billing + batching opt-out" labeled renewal-risk.

zoe_csm: Can someone pull 200 short prompt examples from Acme and a 14-day trace (tokens, batching flag, latency_ms, route)? we'll run quality diffs and quantify tail latency.

anya_eng: I'll own the batching opt-out spike and propose default behavior = batching on unless opt-out is explicit. will include a telemetry panel for batched vs unbatched tail.

devin_sre: I'll export traces and drop a link to the dataset.

maria_cs: Customer quote to preserve in the ticket: "We keep seeing sporadic high charges and can't map them to behavior" and "Batching kills our chat latency."

sam_pm: Action items: anya spike for opt-out (owner), devin trace export (owner), zoe+maria prompt sample+eval, product note for roadmap timing (sam). I'll attach owners to CS-1677.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll share the GTM sync notes after the meeting. :sparkles:
